items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: And of course, I played with Orrin Page, which was called Lips Page.

ctx.x: Well, we don't want to bother you anymore, but unless there's something else you can think about, some of the other trumpet players you'd want to add about, anything about Manuel Perez or any of the others that you were especially close to?

Well, I used to like to meet up with Bunk Johnson when I... Oh, yeah. Bunk, yeah. I've recorded him. He's a particular friend of mine. I like Bunk. Well, Bunk got together in a Port Arthur one time. He said, I want to find that little fellow you all say, play so much trumpet. I want to see who he is. So, I happened to be sitting in a joint over there one night and in came Bunk Johnson. That's the first time I'd ever met him. And we had a session until five, six o'clock in the morning. And we turned to be great…
That was... Were you on that record?
